scopeGuardrail: For CCA-F, generic AWS/Azure/GCP/Kubernetes/networking questions must be rejected unless the infrastructure concept is directly necessary to a Claude solution architecture decision. The primary tested concept must remain within the activated CCA-F objective set. Generation and validation prompts must both enforce this rule.
excludedTopics: Generic AWS service configuration not tied to a Claude solution architecture decision
Generic Azure service configuration not tied to a Claude solution architecture decision
Generic GCP service configuration not tied to a Claude solution architecture decision
Generic Kubernetes administration not tied to a Claude solution architecture decision
General networking topics (routing, DNS, load balancer administration) not tied to a Claude solution architecture decision
Certification content for any exam other than Claude Certified Architect – Foundations
notes: This exclusion list enforces PRD section 5.3 (Scope Guardrail). It is deliberately conservative; the independent reviewer stage must still confirm that any infrastructure concept referenced in a generated question is directly necessary to the tested Claude architecture decision.
